{{Infobox auto}}

'''Oil''' is a cooking [[ingredient]] pressed from sunflowers or [[Cocoa Beans|cocoa beans]]. It is bottled and can't be eaten.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/oil.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A glass bottle and any 3 sunflowers or cocoa beans make 1 oil. Picking up a glass bottle unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

Oil is used for frying and in every oven-meal [[stock]]. Obtaining oil unlocks the four [[Chicken Nugget|chicken nuggets]], [[Buñuelo|buñuelos]], [[Fish and Chips|fish and chips]] and [[lumpia]]. The green curry, paneer curry and pumpkin curry stocks give the oil's glass bottle back, together with the milk bottle's.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/two_glass_bottles_from_crafting.json}}</ref> The other oil recipes are meant to return it too, but in 1.12.2-beta the advancement that does this lists them under old recipe IDs, so the bottle is used up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/mechanics/glass_bottle_from_crafting.json}}</ref> See [[Known bugs]].
